headquarters.address: BuildCem Tower, Plot No. 42, Sector 5, CBD Belapur

mission: To provide high-performance, sustainable building materials through advanced automated production, optimizing resource utilization and maintaining unparalleled supply chain resilience across India.
vision: To be India's most technologically advanced and reliable cement manufacturer, leveraging autonomous intelligence to drive operational excellence, zero downtime, and sustainable industrial growth.
description: BuildCem Industries Pvt. Ltd. is a leading heavy building materials manufacturer in India, operating state-of-the-art integrated cement plants, strategic regional warehouses, and fully automated distribution hubs. Utilizing next-generation logistics systems and deep industrial networks, BuildCem specializes in Ordinary Portland Cement (OPC) and Portland Pozzolana Cement (PPC) tailored for critical infrastructure and urban development.
